content.rendered:
The LRMS school office is closed for the summer and will re-open on Monday, August 14. Back to school and registration night information will be mailed home to families in mid August.


Students new to Sherwood School District: While our school offices are closed during the summer, please deliver completed enrollment forms to the District Office, located at 23295 SW Main Street.  Forms are available online or can be picked up at the District Office. The District Office will be open during the summer on Monday-Thursday, 7:30 am to 4:00 pm.

We look forward to seeing you in August.
